chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever dies in the state of ihram, Allah will resurrect him reciting the talbiyah."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.مُحْرِمًا: in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: What happens to a person who dies while in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one who dies while in the state of ihram will be raised by Allah in that sacred condition, uttering the talbiyah. It highlights the spiritual rank of dying while engaged in an act of worship connected to hajj or 'umrah and points to the continuing effect of that state into resurrection.
